background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: Wells Fargo is rated A on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 29 Sep 2026 that also resolved a positive outlook. Capital is the weak spot against US banks, CET1 of 10.3% in the bottom quarter, with leverage of 5.8% and LCR of 119% above the peer median. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 and leverage have each fallen 0.9 points while LCR has been broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The rating action of 29 Sep 2026 is the news that matters; the rest of the flagged items say little about credit.
